title: Road surfaces are cut at a uniform step on any curve
symptom: a tight curve's inner edge stands 5.6 cm off the true curve while a gentle avenue spends five times the triangles it needs
cause: surface_steps (native/src/render/roads/road_emit.cpp:29) cuts every curved or graded segment into equal pieces of streets.json sample_step_m (3 m; far 24 m), whatever the curve; markings and verge repeat the step
criterion: a probe holds the mesh's largest deviation from the curve under a tolerance in data, and a straight road on a constant grade has two stations

title: A green band of verge runs beside every road
symptom: a strip of grass, the verge, lies between the footway and the terrain along every road (the owner, 2026-11-08: the terrain must meet the road)
cause: the verge ribbon (native/src/render/roads/road_verge.cpp) carried from the old 4.0 draws a band from the footway's edge down to the terrain instead of the terrain meeting the road's edge
criterion: photos by the image protocol show the terrain meeting the footway's back with no band, near and far, several angles
